title: Thoughts on the TauricResearch/TradingAgents framework?
author: EmergencyFarm7130
selftext:
Has anyone here used the `TauricResearch/TradingAgents` repo for their setups? It looks like a great concept using LLM agents for different roles (analyst, risk manager, etc.).

For those who have tested it:

1. Is it actually effective for real-world trading?
2. Did you run into major issues with the AI hallucinating (either messing up the math or losing track of its goals)?
